name: Workspace recovery
description: In the event of unintentional workspace deletions, this feature allows tenant admins to recover workspaces, including Fabric items. Admins can set recovery policies and recover the deleted workspaces within a specified timeframe. Deleted workspaces are soft deleted and recoverable by the tenant admins. Tenant admins will be able to configure the retention period via a setting in the Fabric admin portal. This capability, is already supported for workspaces with Power BI items, and it will extend to include workspaces with Fabric items.
